description: Use this when the user asks about an app's downloads, sales, proceeds or refunds. Not for which ad brought a download. Apple's own daily App Store numbers from App Store Connect (Sales and Trends), organic and paid alike: first-time downloads, re-downloads, updates, in-app purchases, new and renewed subscriptions, refunds and the developer's proceeds (after Apple's commission and taxes, net of refunds, in the currency Apple pays for each storefront), per app by day, storefront country or product. Days are Pacific Time, Apple's report day; each day comes out the next morning and is synced within six hours. Says nothing about which ad brought a download.

app.description: An Apptiller app (name or id from apps) or an App Store Apple ID. All apps when left out.

by.description: day: one row per app and day; country: per storefront over the range; product: per in-app purchase or subscription (and the app itself) over the range.
